summaries.Romania: President Nicușor Dan held a marathon press conference addressing budget deficits, AUR governance risks, and press freedom concerns after banning a journalist from Cotroceni. Romania faces critical fiscal challenges with a projected 150 billion lei deficit in 2026 and potential IMF intervention if rating downgrades occur.
summaries.Healthcare: Oura acquired AI primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M, signaling major consolidation in digital health, while the FDA warned GLP-1 drugs pose rare eye condition risks and approved Bayer's first-in-class stroke prevention drug. Healthcare innovation continues accelerating through AI integration and novel therapeutics despite regulatory scrutiny.
summaries.Tech: Apple launched its first touchscreen MacBook Pro with PROLED display and dynamic island, while Anthropic founders each plan to cash out ~$250M in upcoming IPO and OpenAI acquired Odessia travel startup. Major tech companies are consolidating around AI capabilities and hardware innovation as competition intensifies.

items.title: Primele hiper-centre de date AI din România. Vor consuma energie cât tot Bucureștiul într-o zi de caniculă, dar permanent, zi și noapte
items.snippet: Autoritățile din România discută deja cu investitorii în mari centre de date AI, iar Transelectrica a emis avize tehnice de racordare pentru primele astfel de capacități.  Mari centre AI în România „Ne întâlnim permanent cu consumatorii de energie electrică, inclusiv cu potențiali investitori în cen
items.line: Romania's first AI data centers could consume as much electricity as all of Bucharest, signaling massive energy demands for the country's tech ambitions.

items.title: Avertismentul președintelui Nicușor Dan: Deficitul pe 2026 ajunge la 150 de miliarde de lei / Există pericolul intervenției FMI / „Cheltuim bani pe care nu îi avem”
items.snippet: Președintele României, Nicușor Dan, a transmis marți seara, în cadrul unei conferințe de presă un semnal de alarmă privind starea finanțelor publice, avertizând că deficitul bugetar proiectat pentru anul 2026 se ridică la 150 de miliarde de lei — o sumă echivalentă cu întreaga alocare a României pri
items.line: Romania's 2026 budget deficit projected at 150 billion lei with FMI intervention risk if investor confidence erodes, threatening the country's economic stability.

items.title: STAT+: GLP-1s are given an FDA warning for rare eye condition risk
items.snippet: The FDA warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk of a rare but serious eye condition sometimes referred to as an “eye stroke.”
items.line: FDA warned GLP-1 drugs carry potential risk of rare serious eye condition, prompting immediate patient awareness despite small reported incidence.

items.title: STAT+: Oura to acquire Counsel Health for $625 million, placing a big bet on AI care
items.snippet: Oura, the smart ring maker that recently delayed plans to go public, said it will pay $625 million to acquire Counsel Health, a clinical AI startup.
items.line: FDA approved Bayer's asundexian (Sunharbo), first-in-class drug reducing stroke recurrence risk, marking significant cardiovascular innovation.

items.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
items.snippet: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”
items.line: Oura acquired Counsel Health for $625M to integrate clinical AI and virtual primary care, signaling major digital health consolidation around AI capabilities.

items.snippet:
iFixit published its teardown of the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display today, revealing interesting details about how Apple brought back its illuminated logo on the lid. Watch it below.

items.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
items.snippet: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
items.line: All seven Anthropic co-founders plan to each cash out ~$250M in upcoming IPO while maintaining group control of the AI company.

items.title: Fără precedent. Președintele Nicușor Dan i-a spus în direct unui jurnalist că va fi interzis la Cotroceni de acum încolo: „Dumneavoastră nu veți mai veni la conferințele mele în acest mandat”

Anunțul a fost făcut chiar de președinte la finalul conferinței de presă de marți seara de la Cotroceni, atunci când jurnalistul i-a adresat o întrebare. Jurnalistul tocmai îl întrebase pe p
items.line: President Nicușor Dan barred journalist Ovidiu Vanghele from Cotroceni conferences, triggering rare press freedom criticism from USR, PNL, and civil society figures.

items.title: CMS makes it official, codifying Medicare drug price negotiations established under IRA
items.snippet: Against a backdrop of repeated industry challenges in court, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services is locking in the drug price negotiation framework established under the Biden-era Inflation Reduction Act.
items.line: CMS codified Medicare drug price negotiations under the Inflation Reduction Act despite repeated pharma industry legal challenges.

items.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
items.snippet: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.
items.line: OpenAI acquires Odessia travel startup co-founded by Sonder's Francis Davidson, expanding AI applications into travel industry.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.snippet: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
items.line: New York's AI safety law takes effect requiring OpenAI, Anthropic to register, disclose practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
items.snippet: As participants talk, Claude can draft the plan being discussed, map out a timeline on a whiteboard, answer questions in the meeting chat, and access connected work apps to retrieve information, such as last year's figures.
items.line: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into actionable plans, drafts, and timelines with integrated app access.

items.title: Producție mutată din Italia spre România. Indienii de la Varroc favorizează din nou piața locală
items.snippet: Producătorul indian de componente auto Varroc Engineering anunță că mută o parte din producție din Italia spre Târgu Mureș și Hanoi. Este argumentat că, la acest moment, fabrica din Cambiano funcționează doar la 35,9% din capacitate. Citește mai mult pe Profit.ro
items.line: Varroc Engineering shifts auto component production from Italy to Romania (Târgu Mureș), reflecting competitive manufacturing advantages in Central Europe.
